title: SOLID
description: Single responsibility, open/closed, Liskov substitution, interface segregation and dependency inversion in classes.

title: Simplicity
description: Do not repeat yourself, keep it simple, you are not going to need it, and the law of Demeter.

title: Clean Code
description: Size and shape of functions and classes, placeholders, dead and commented-out code, empty catch blocks, naming.

title: Object-oriented design
description: Encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, cohesion and coupling of classes, god classes and feature envy.

title: Functional style
description: Purity, side effects in lambdas, mutable state, recursion and depth of higher-order functions.

title: Structured programming
description: Goto, global state and module size.

title: Architecture
description: Distance from the main sequence, dependency cycles, layer violations, god classes, feature envy and blast radius.

title: Maintainability
description: Cyclomatic complexity, maintainability index, duplication and test coverage.

title: Performance
description: Estimates of time and space complexity, quadratic patterns and allocations in hot loops.

title: Design patterns
description: Recognized patterns (singleton, factory, strategy, observer, decorator, repository, builder) and anti-patterns (service locator, anemic model, middle man).

title: Security
description: Hardcoded secrets, insecure deserialization and SQL built by concatenation, as heuristics.
